1.负责用户听力咨询、病史采集、耳道观察及纯音测听等基础听力评估，准确解读检测结果，规范记录听力数据与服务档案；

2.突发故障应急响应：执行值班制度，对突发设备故障进行快速响应与处置；
3.日常保养与点检：严格执行设备保养规程，完成日/周/月定期保养；通过“望、闻、问、切”进行日常点检，识别异常状态；
4.预防性检修执行：根据计划完成设备定期解体检查、性能测试、精度校准及磨损件更换；
5.维修记录管理：准确填写维修工单与检修报告，记录故障现象、原因、处理措施及更换部件，实现过程可追溯。

2、良好的沟通能力，动手能力强，具备大华DHSA/DHSP认证证书优先考虑；
3、正直诚信，抗压力强，对工作充满热情，有良好的团队合作意识；
4、能适应频繁跑动或出差；
5、需接受全国工作地点调配。

1、负责国内交付项目管理工作，对解决方案型项目交付过程进行管理，对项目过程风险进行把控，主动识别问题和技术困难，调动后端资源解决问题，配合销售与合作伙伴完成项目交付，提升用户体验满意度；
2、对解决方案型项目的平台软件/硬件产品进行部署和调试，能够结合项目现网环境，对平台软件践行部署调试，能够使用统一部署工具、Linux系统、数据库系统等服务端系统的脚本命令进行软件平台的部署交付；
3、根据售前设计方案，对解决方案型项目交付的落地技术方案进行细化设计，将用户原始需求转化为软件产品需求导入后台研发端定制，完成客户端需求交付工作；
4、独立或指导他人完成平台软件经验案例、软件项目交付文档的输出，加强省区软件能力；
5、职位发展方向：技术专家、软件平台专家、解决方案专家、销售专家。

note:

“理想+”是理想汽车面向全球顶尖技术人才的校园招聘计划。我们期待你的加入，与理想汽车一起成长、分享收获，通过人工智能技术去改变物理世界的效率和体验，造福我们服务的每一个家庭，以及家庭里的每一位成员。

【本岗位的主要工作内容】
1. 核心算法研发：负责具身智能大模型（VLA，即视觉语言行动模型）的核心算法设计与优化，重点突破多模态指令理解、复杂任务决策、长时序动作规划等关键技术，推动模型在真实机器人场景下的零样本/少样本泛化能力；
2. 端到端模型与系统设计：主导机器人端到端感知-决策-控制一体化模型的研究与落地，探索扩散策略、世界模型、强化学习等前沿技术在具身智能系统中的融合应用，实现从仿真到现实（Sim2Real）的高效迁移；
3. 数据驱动模型闭环：设计并构建大规模、高质量的多模态数据（视频、力觉、触觉、文本）采集、清洗、标注与仿真生成pipeline，主导数据-模型联合迭代优化，解决长尾分布与数据稀缺问题；
4. 仿真与真实世界对齐：负责高保真仿真环境的动力学建模、场景生成与传感器仿真，研究领域随机化与领域自适应技术，缩小仿真与现实之间的差距，提升模型在真实物理世界的部署性能；
5. 前沿技术探索与转化：跟踪并引领具身智能、机器人学、计算机视觉、自然语言处理交叉领域的前沿技术动态，主导关键技术难点的攻关，发表高水平论文并申请核心发明专利，推动研究成果向实际产品的技术转化。

下一代具身智能大脑研究

任职要求：

3. 模型与算法：深入理解Transformer、Diffusion Models、多模态预训练、强化学习、模仿学习等核心算法原理，具备从零构建或深度优化大模型的经验；熟悉模型量化、剪枝、蒸馏等端侧部署优化技术者优先；
4. 系统与开发能力：具备卓越的编程能力，精通Python和C++，熟练掌握PyTorch/TensorFlow等主流深度学习框架；具备复杂的机器人系统（包括感知、规划、控制）的仿真或实际开发经验，熟悉ROS/ROS2；

We are looking for young talents who are passionate about finance, logical, rigorous and detail-oriented, and willing to actively participate in building an integrated overseas business-finance system. In this role, you will systematically learn core finance functions—including accounting, analysis and reporting—through hands-on work and ongoing mentorship, understand the business logic behind the numbers, and participate in the implementation of business-finance systemization in finance scenarios, gradually growing into a professional accounting talent for overseas business.
Job Responsibilities
1. Participate in overseas business accounting and build a solid finance foundation
Participate in overseas daily bookkeeping, business-finance reconciliation and monthly closing; understand the relationship between business transactions and financial records; and ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial data. Areas covered include bank deposits, accounts receivable and payable, account clearing, customer reconciliation, payroll, expenses, taxes, export tax rebates, fixed assets and leases.
2. Support financial analysis and understand business operations
Perform variance analysis on the accounting subjects you are responsible for, raise early warnings on abnormal operating data, and align improvement recommendations with relevant parties and follow up on implementation.
3. Promote systemization and automation of overseas business-finance processes
Actively participate in building an integrated overseas business-finance system in your areas of responsibility, promote automation of accounting processes, reduce manual bookkeeping, and improve work efficiency and quality.

任职要求：
1. Professional foundation: 2027 fresh graduates; majors in finance, accounting, economics, banking or statistics. English and Russian as working languages.
2. Detail-oriented and reliable: Strong sense of responsibility; sensitive to details such as numbers, dates and terms; careful and patient in work.
3. Proactive learning: Proactive and positive, willing to continuously improve, and committed to deepening expertise in accounting within the new energy vehicle industry.
What We Offer
1. Hands-on overseas finance experience in a large high-tech manufacturing company: Participate in daily finance and business analysis for the overseas operations of a U.S.-listed company, and gain experience across multiple country entities, multiple currencies and multiple accounting standards.
2. Continuous mentorship and multi-module learning: Start with specific tasks and gradually expand professional capabilities across multiple accounting cycles, including accounting, analysis, reporting and the building of an integrated overseas business-finance system.
3. Growth opportunities: Based on individual capabilities and business needs, gradually take on more complex finance modules and develop toward roles such as finance backbone, regional/country BP, management reporting, and finance operations.
4. Practical opportunities to combine AI with finance: Join the AI community and explore the application of AI tools in scenarios such as report generation, data reconciliation and financial bookkeeping.

岗位职责：
We are looking for young talents who are curious about business, think clearly, are willing to speak up, and are ready to go to the front line of our overseas business. Through real work and mentorship, you will systematically learn about and be deeply involved in budgeting, analysis and business decision-making, understand the underlying logic of how the business really works, and take part in building integrated business and finance systems overseas — growing into an overseas finance business partner who can make decisions shoulder to shoulder with the business.
Job Responsibilities
1. Step onto the business front line and become a finance partner who understands the business
Work closely with overseas markets and business teams to understand how sales, channels, after-sales and supply chain operate and how they make money; join business reviews and stand shoulder to shoulder with business leaders — translating business actions into financial language, and bringing a finance perspective into every decision.
2. Let the data speak and support business decisions
Contribute to overseas budgeting and rolling forecasts, and build and continuously refine country/market profitability models; break results down across volume, price, cost and profit, deliver monthly business analysis and variance attribution, and flag risks early while identifying growth opportunities — giving decision-makers the basis for pricing, channel investment and resource allocation.
3. Drive business improvement so that analysis truly delivers results
Go beyond "finding the problem": work with the business to shape improvement plans, follow through on pricing strategy, channel efficiency, inventory turnover, delivery and fulfilment, and track the impact through a closed data loop — turning every analysis into real business improvement.
4. Take part in building overseas finance digitalization
Drive the implementation of integrated business and finance systems in overseas scenarios, support system optimization, and contribute to building and automating business dashboards, profitability models and forecasting tools — so that data reaches the decision table faster and more accurately.

任职要求：
1. Professional background and languages: 2027 fresh graduates; majors in finance, accounting, economics, banking or statistics. English and Russian as working languages.
2. Commercial acumen: Sensitive to numbers and business logic; able to see business problems and opportunities through the numbers in reports, rather than merely completing a calculation.
3. Communication and influence: Articulate and rigorous in logic; able to turn financial conclusions into judgements the business can act on, and willing to hold a professional position in business discussions.
4. Ownership and resilience: Willing to go to the overseas front line, comfortable with multiple tasks and a fast pace, and proactive in finding answers amid uncertainty.
What We Offer
1. A front-row seat in overseas expansion
Join the real operations of a U.S.-listed company's overseas business; work across multiple country entities, multiple currencies and multiple accounting standards in complex operating scenarios and resource allocation; and witness, end to end, a Chinese company going global.
2. A growth path from "doing the numbers" to "running the business"
Your work goes beyond reporting: you take part in decisions on pricing, investment, channels and resources, and test your own judgement against real business results.
3. Continuous mentorship and a broad runway
Start from specific modules and, through mentorship and cross-market exposure, gradually take on fuller business-analysis responsibilities, developing towards regional/country finance BP, product-line/cost BP, FP&A and other directions.
4. Hands-on practice combining AI and finance
